evals.name: oas32-element-field-set
evals.prompt: We're adding OpenAPI 3.2.0 support to ApiDOM as a new namespace package apidom-ns-openapi-3-2 that extends apidom-ns-openapi-3-1. Spec: https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/versions/3.2.0.md. For now I only need the element layer: (1) field-map.md listing, per object, the fields that are new in 3.2 compared to ApiDOM's 3.1 namespace, and (2) the element class files (src/elements/*.ts and src/elements/nces/*.ts) for every element that needs a 3.2-specific class, including JsonSchemaDialect.ts with the correct default dialect URL.
evals.expected_output: Element classes that add exactly the fields new in OAS 3.2 and nothing inherited from 3.1; correct value types; verified dialect URL.
assertions: Components does not redefine pathItems (already in OAS 3.1)
No webhooks field or ComponentsWebhooks element under Components
Encoding adds encoding, prefixEncoding and itemEncoding
MediaType adds itemSchema, prefixEncoding and itemEncoding
prefixEncoding is typed as an array and itemEncoding as an Encoding element
OAuthFlow adds deviceAuthorizationUrl and OAuthFlows adds deviceAuthorization
Tag adds summary, parent and kind
Example adds dataValue and serializedValue; Discriminator adds defaultMapping; Server adds name
PathItem adds query and additionalOperations; root element adds $self
License does not redefine identifier and Info does not redefine summary (both in OAS 3.1)
No duplicated parent root element file (OpenApi3-1.ts)
